\section[(dialogue)]{Places and the house — a first pass}

\label{lesson:MR-R140-first-pass-places-and-the-house}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for a rock and a wave.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item a curtain, a lock, a bucket, a rope, a nail
  \item a hammer, scissors, a needle, a thread, a comb
  \item soap, a box, a bag, a basket, a candle
  \item a bowl, a cooking pot, a blackboard, a pencil, an eraser
  \item a school bag, an exam, a class, study, a shirt
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
A curtain? (\textbf{\mr{पडदा}}, \emph{paḍdā}.) A lock? (\textbf{\mr{कुलूप}}, \emph{kulūp}.) A bucket? (\textbf{\mr{बादली}}, \emph{bādlī}.) A rope? (\textbf{\mr{दोरी}}, \emph{dorī}.) A nail? (\textbf{\mr{खिळा}}, \emph{khiḷā}.) A hammer? (\textbf{\mr{हातोडा}}, \emph{hātoḍā}.) Scissors? (\textbf{\mr{कात्री}}, \emph{kātrī}.) A needle? (\textbf{\mr{सुई}}, \emph{suī}.) A thread? (\textbf{\mr{दोरा}}, \emph{dorā}.) A comb? (\textbf{\mr{कंगवा}}, \emph{kaṅgvā}.) Soap? (\textbf{\mr{साबण}}, \emph{sābaṇ}.) A box? (\textbf{\mr{पेटी}}, \emph{peṭī}.) A bag? (\textbf{\mr{पिशवी}}, \emph{piśvī}.) A basket? (\textbf{\mr{टोपली}}, \emph{ṭoplī}.) A candle? (\textbf{\mr{मेणबत्ती}}, \emph{meṇbattī}.) A bowl? (\textbf{\mr{वाटी}}, \emph{vāṭī}.) A cooking pot? (\textbf{\mr{पातेले}}, \emph{pātele}.) A blackboard? (\textbf{\mr{फळा}}, \emph{phaḷā}.) A pencil? (\textbf{\mr{पेन्सिल}}, \emph{pensil}.) An eraser? (\textbf{\mr{रबर}}, \emph{rabar}.) A school bag? (\textbf{\mr{दप्तर}}, \emph{daptar}.) An exam? (\textbf{\mr{परीक्षा}}, \emph{parīkṣā}.) A class? (\textbf{\mr{वर्ग}}, \emph{varg}.) Study? (\textbf{\mr{अभ्यास}}, \emph{abhyās}.) A shirt? (\textbf{\mr{शर्ट}}, \emph{śarṭ}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[(dialogue)]{Things you use — a second pass}

\label{lesson:MR-R140-second-pass-things-you-use}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for a coat and a jumper.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item a coat, a jumper, a chapati, a vegetable dish, plain dal
  \item flattened rice, a ladoo, a cucumber, garlic, ginger
  \item peas, a pomegranate, a watermelon, a coconut, flour
  \item a hill, a spring, a waterfall, grass, a branch
  \item a root, a seed, soil, a rock, a wave
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
A coat? (\textbf{\mr{कोट}}, \emph{koṭ}.) A jumper? (\textbf{\mr{स्वेटर}}, \emph{sveṭar}.) A chapati? (\textbf{\mr{पोळी}}, \emph{poḷī}.) A vegetable dish? (\textbf{\mr{भाजी}}, \emph{bhājī}.) Plain dal? (\textbf{\mr{वरण}}, \emph{varaṇ}.) Flattened rice? (\textbf{\mr{पोहे}}, \emph{pohe}.) A ladoo? (\textbf{\mr{लाडू}}, \emph{lāḍū}.) A cucumber? (\textbf{\mr{काकडी}}, \emph{kākḍī}.) Garlic? (\textbf{\mr{लसूण}}, \emph{lasūṇ}.) Ginger? (\textbf{\mr{आले}}, \emph{āle}.) Peas? (\textbf{\mr{मटार}}, \emph{maṭār}.) A pomegranate? (\textbf{\mr{डाळिंब}}, \emph{ḍāḷimb}.) A watermelon? (\textbf{\mr{कलिंगड}}, \emph{kaliṅgaḍ}.) A coconut? (\textbf{\mr{नारळ}}, \emph{nāraḷ}.) Flour? (\textbf{\mr{पीठ}}, \emph{pīṭh}.) A hill? (\textbf{\mr{टेकडी}}, \emph{ṭekḍī}.) A spring? (\textbf{\mr{झरा}}, \emph{jharā}.) A waterfall? (\textbf{\mr{धबधबा}}, \emph{dhabdhabā}.) Grass? (\textbf{\mr{गवत}}, \emph{gavat}.) A branch? (\textbf{\mr{फांदी}}, \emph{phāndī}.) A root? (\textbf{\mr{मूळ}}, \emph{mūḷ}.) A seed? (\textbf{\mr{बी}}, \emph{bī}.) Soil? (\textbf{\mr{माती}}, \emph{mātī}.) A rock? (\textbf{\mr{खडक}}, \emph{khaḍak}.) A wave? (\textbf{\mr{लाट}}, \emph{lāṭ}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
